_note: GM personality presets (DESIGN.md section 9). Every dial is 0..1 except difficulty (encounter size multiplier, 1 = standard). Our own data.

dials.aggression: How much the GM values attacking over staying safe.
dials.caution: How much it values cover and staying out of enemy reach; damaged units retreat sooner.
dials.focus_fire: 1 = gang up on the most hurt target, 0 = spread attacks around.
dials.reinforcements: Chance per round, after round 2, that reinforcements arrive (missions that allow them).
dials.randomness: How unpredictable choices are (noise added to every score).
dials.approach: Basic Combat: the most rows between the two deployment zones (0 = the map edges). 14 means first contact by about turn 2 for Speed 4 mechs.
dials.environments: Chance that weather or a world that suggests a rules environment (sandstorm, blizzard, low gravity...) brings that environment's rules into the mission.

Standard.description: A real fight: about one and a half enemies per pilot that use cover, gang up on whoever is hurt, and call in reinforcements. Expect to lose mechs.

Ruthless.description: Enemies gang up on the weakest pilot and press every advantage.

Cautious.description: Enemies hug cover, keep their distance and pull back when hurt.

Chaotic.description: Unpredictable: wild moves, scattered attacks, surprise reinforcements.

Teaching.description: Gentle: smaller fights, spread-out attacks, and every enemy move explained.

fight_lengths_note: Fight length (GM dial, separate from the preset): scales only the GM's choices the book leaves to the GM: encounter size (multiplies the enemy budget), deployment distance (rows added to the approach dial) and how early an enemy commander considers yielding (fraction of their force down; Core p.60 lets the GM end a fight once its outcome isn't in question). Never HP, damage or any rule. Times are rough solo estimates.

short.label: Short
short.description: About 15-25 minutes solo: fewer enemies, closer deployment, and enemy commanders give up sooner.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: About 20-40 minutes solo: the GM style's usual fight.

long.label: Long
long.description: About 40-60 minutes or more solo: bigger forces, a longer approach, and commanders who hold out longer.
